description: Experience endless outdoor fun with Rothco’s Wooden Boomerang! Unlike a Frisbee, this traditional boomerang is designed to return to you with every throw, adding a magical twist to your activities. Measuring approximately 17 ¾ inches x 7 inches, it’s the perfect size for both children and adults, offering easy handling and precision. Made from high-quality wood, Rothco’s Boomerang is crafted for durability in all weather conditions, ensuring it can be used year-round. Whether you’re at the park, the beach, or your own backyard, this boomerang provides hours of engaging entertainment. It’s a great way to stay active, enjoy the outdoors, and challenge yourself or your friends with every throw.
